limitation: Exploratory overnight follow-up on the same fixed four-root/four-copy structural scaffold. New numeric seeds, queries and constant-root formats are not independent structural or causal replications. Only TRAIN neutral rows fit normalizers and ridge heads. The fixed categorical value pipeline and direct relation pipeline have different total parameter counts. Source-valued and hidden-valued baselines are both retained. Relations are oracle targets, never features. Constant-expression canonicalization is target-only; feature prefixes are the actual captured source. Conditional intervals resample nine development components without refitting or multiplicity correction. Weighting seeds and lexical/query relatives are not independent experiments. Whole-row donor controls preserve unweighted split marginals; weighted marginals and task difficulty may differ. Parent reconstruction assumes known node/version identities and does not establish natural causal use.

protocol.output_ancestry: actual query slot at pre_answer; never canonicalized to v0
protocol.shuffle: split/component derangement; base-block permutation; first-parent permutation; lexical/query ties
protocol.source_features: signed character ngrams 3..8, matched hidden width
